_comment: THE site URL. Every place the domain appears is generated from here.
The domain is NOT chosen yet. ryanbeck.com is taken and Ryan's name is
common enough that the eventual address will be something else. Nothing
below is a decision -- it is a stand-in that keeps the markup valid.
To change it: edit `origin` (and `name` if the wordmark changes), then
run `npm run site-url`. That rewrites the canonical tags, OG tags,
sitemap, robots.txt, wrangler route and the fetchers' user-agent, and
regenerates the dashboard. `npm test` fails if any file has drifted from
this file, so a stray hardcoded domain cannot survive CI.
Set `chosen` to true once the real domain is registered and pointed.
name: Ryan Beck
